_comment: Tier-2 for sparta adaptive_grid: 'adapt_grid ... value f_<fixID>' before the fix has produced output reads every cell as 0. With the default 'thresh more less' SPARTA prints '  no grid adaptation performed' and no 'cells refined' line (rc=0, no warning); after a run the same command refines 395 of 400 cells. The zeros are NOT harmless: a 'coarsen' action on the same unfed fix coarsens 100 cells. Also gates the bracket rule — a single-value fix ave/grid is a per-grid VECTOR, so 'value f_ID[1]' aborts with 'Adapt fix does not calculate a per-grid array'. COVERS (added 2026-08-06): adaptive_grid:0 via unfed_fix_prints_no_adaptation_line and coarsen_on_unfed_fix_is_not_a_noop, and adaptive_grid:1 via bracketed_single_value_fix_aborts, which is the 'Adapt fix does not calculate a per-grid array (../adapt_grid.cpp:484)' bracket rule.
